newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks rebound on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks rebound on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rebounded on short-covering on Monday and dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said prices were likely to rise across the board.
The Karachi 100-share index, which opened lower, rebounded and rose 9.30 points, or 0.65 percent, to 1,552.76 at 11.04 a.m. (0604 GMT).
Dealer Azhar Batla attributed the rise to short-covering in almost all big speculative stocks before Tuesday's settlement day. "Prices are likely to rise further," he said.
Hub Power Company Ltd rose 0.30 rupee to 37.90, PTCL 0.50 to 26.20 and ICI Pakistan 0.20 to 24.70.
